For instructions on using the CLUE software, visit this link.

For instructions on using the Storm Explorer simulation, watch this video.

The File menu and the editing buttons in the workspace are not active. If you click them, there will be no response.

To read and post a comment, select a tile in the Daily Update. Comments do not support threads, links, images, or copy/paste.

Storm Explorer is for educational purposes only and cannot be used to create actual forecasts. The simulation necessarily has simplified the system. Please note the simulation cannot update daily dynamic ocean temperature and atmospheric wind and pressure conditions and simulated storm paths do not include timing information. It does however take into account environmental conditions important for understanding what steers storms and affects storm strength.
